record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Muthlabben<WH04192><WH01121>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> <FI>thee<Fi> , O LORD<WH03068>, with my whole heart<WH03820>; I will shew forth<WH05608><WTH8762> all thy marvellous works<WH06381><WTH8737>.
I will be glad<WH08055><WTH8799> and rejoice<WH05970><WTH8799> in thee: I will sing praise<WH02167><WTH8762> to thy name<WH08034>, O thou most High<WH05945>.
When mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> are turned<WH07725><WTH8800> back<WH0268>, they shall fall<WH03782><WTH8735> and perish<WH06><WTH8799> at thy presence<WH06440>.

For thou hast maintained<WH06213><WTH8804> my right<WH04941> and my cause<WH01779>; thou satest<WH03427><WTH8804> in the throne<WH03678> judging<WH08199><WTH8802> right<WH06664>. <RF>maintained...: Heb. made my judgment<Rf> <RF>judging right: Heb. judging in righteousness<Rf>

Thou hast rebuked<WH01605><WTH8804> the heathen<WH01471>, thou hast destroyed<WH06><WTH8765> the wicked<WH07563>, thou hast put out<WH04229><WTH8804> their name<WH08034> for ever<WH05769> and ever<WH05703>.

O thou enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, destructions<WH02723> are come to a perpetual<WH05331> end<WH08552><WTH8804>: and thou hast destroyed<WH05428><WTH8804> cities<WH06145><WTH8676><WH05892>; their memorial<WH02143> is perished<WH06><WTH8804> with them<WH01992>. <RF>O thou...: or, The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast thou destroyed, etc<Rf>
But the LORD<WH03068> shall endure<WH03427><WTH8799> for ever<WH05769>: he hath prepared<WH03559><WTH8790> his throne<WH03678> for judgment<WH04941>.
And he shall judge<WH08199><WTH8799> the world<WH08398> in righteousness<WH06664>, he shall minister judgment<WH01777><WTH8799> to the people<WH03816> in uprightness<WH04339>.
The LORD<WH03068> also will be a refuge<WH04869> for the oppressed<WH01790>, a refuge<WH04869> in times<WH06256> of trouble<WH06869>. <RF>a refuge: Heb. an high place<Rf>

And they that know<WH03045><WTH8802> thy name<WH08034> will put their trust<WH0982><WTH8799> in thee: for thou, LORD<WH03068>, hast not forsaken<WH05800><WTH8804> them that seek<WH01875><WTH8802> thee.<CM>
Sing praises<WH02167><WTH8761> to the LORD<WH03068>, which dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8802> in Zion<WH06726>: declare<WH05046><WTH8685> among the people<WH05971> his doings<WH05949>.

When he maketh inquisition<WH01875><WTH8802> for blood<WH01818>, he remembereth<WH02142><WTH8804> them: he forgetteth<WH07911><WTH8804> not the cry<WH06818> of the humble<WH06035><WTH8675><WH06041>. <RF>humble: or, afflicted<Rf>

Have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me, O LORD<WH03068>; consider<WH07200><WTH8798> my trouble<WH06040> <FI>which I suffer<Fi> of them that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me, thou that liftest me up<WH07311><WTH8789> from the gates<WH08179> of death<WH04194>:
That I may shew forth<WH05608><WTH8762> all thy praise<WH08416> in the gates<WH08179> of the daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>: I will rejoice<WH01523><WTH8799> in thy salvation<WH03444>.

The heathen<WH01471> are sunk down<WH02883><WTH8804> in the pit<WH07845> <FI>that<Fi> they made<WH06213><WTH8804>: in the net<WH07568> which<WH02098> they hid<WH02934><WTH8804> is their own foot<WH07272> taken<WH03920><WTH8738>.

The LORD<WH03068> is known<WH03045><WTH8738> <FI>by<Fi> the judgment<WH04941> <FI>which<Fi> he executeth<WH06213><WTH8804>: the wicked<WH07563> is snared<WH05367><WTH8804> in the work<WH06467> of his own hands<WH03709>. Higgaion<WH01902>. Selah<WH05542>. <RF>Higgaion: that is, Meditation<Rf>
The wicked<WH07563> shall be turned<WH07725><WTH8799> into hell<WH07585>, <FI>and<Fi> all the nations<WH01471> that forget<WH07913> God<WH0430>.

For the needy<WH034> shall not alway<WH05331> be forgotten<WH07911><WTH8735>: the expectation<WH08615> of the poor<WH06041><WTH8675><WH06035> shall <FI>not<Fi> perish<WH06><WTH8799> for ever<WH05703>.
Arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>; let not man<WH0582> prevail<WH05810><WTH8799>: let the heathen<WH01471> be judged<WH08199><WTH8735> in thy sight<WH06440>.

Put<WH07896><WTH8798> them in fear<WH04172><WTH8675><WH04172>, O LORD<WH03068>: <FI>that<Fi> the nations<WH01471> may know<WH03045><WTH8799> themselves <FI>to be but<Fi> men<WH0582>. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>
